enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +29: Passive: +29 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Lightning Lore +21: Passive: Your Electricity spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Magnetism +142: Passive: +142 Equipment bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Insightful Magnetism +71: Passive: +71 Insight bonus to Electricity Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +7: +7 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Fusible: Something about this item looks incomplete. Perhaps in the future it will be compatible with another item to create a brand-new fusion of the two.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
